{{Money|1,250}} every 25% health (Hard) |hidden = No |fly = {{Attr|Flying|Yes}} |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Stun}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|In The Spotlight}}''' - Casts light upon an enemy in its range of 15, healing all enemies in a 15 radius by 40 health every 0.2 tick. }} ==Description== '''Spotlight''' was a support that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It was a large [[flying]] enemy that had significantly higher health but slower speed than the [[Performer]] that appeared before it. It has one ability, where it casts light from its spotlight head to heal enemies by 40 health every 0.2 tick. This ability has a range of 15 and a spotlight radius of 15. ==Logbook Description== "''The Spotlight is a flying enemy with a large spotlight for a head that illuminates Narrator's stage. The Spotlight has the ability to heal other enemies, making it a priority target. Sometimes, the Painter Men will stand beneath it to paint on their canvas faces.''" ==Appearance== The '''Spotlight''' is a humanoid object-headed robot which has a giant spotlight instead of a head. It has black arms and a floating ring above it. It wears a red shirt, blue pants and black shoes. Using its spotlight head, it will cast light on enemies near it. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *'''Spotlights''' themselves are not a threat due to their mediocre speed and comparatively low health, rather becoming a problem through their main ability, ''In The Spotlight''. This ability heals any enemies in a radius, which can become a major issue if left unattended. **The [[Ranger]] can quickly deal with them, though due to their slowness, enemies being healed will likely need to be cleared out first. **The [[Mortar]] is also particularly effective, thanks to being indiscriminate towards the concept of crowds. **The [[Pursuit]] can also be used, as it has flying detection, full map wide range through its ''Reposition'' and it has missiles that allow it to deal damage to both the '''Spotlight''' and the enemies it is healing. *The [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give towers flying detection if needed. **The [[UAV]] can also be used, but only in the Easy difficulty. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} SpotlightFloat.gif|Floating animation (20 December 2025 – Present) SpotlightDeath.gif|Death animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSpotlight.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SpotlightIconIG.png|'''Spotlight''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Spotlight''' is the largest enemy in the game to always have the [[Flying]] attribute. **Counting enemies that have [[Flying]] added through abilities, the [[Frost Spirit]] takes this spot instead. **Adding onto this, the '''Spotlight''' is one of the largest non-boss enemies in the entire game, possibly only being beaten out by the [[Null Accelerator]] or [[Null Necromancer]]. *The '''Spotlight''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' -
